props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: itemRender
props.description:
Component rendered for every item, replacing its default link or page element (the `<li>` and
separator are kept). Use it to integrate a router link. Receives `{ item, index, active,
disabled }`; you are responsible for `aria-current` and disabled handling.

props.name: items
props.description:
Items of the trail, from the root to the current page. Separators are rendered between
consecutive items automatically.
examples:
import { Breadcrumb } from 'moraine'

<Breadcrumb
  items={[
    { label: 'Home', href: '/' },
    { label: 'Docs', href: '/docs', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' },
    { label: 'Archive', disabled: true },
    { label: 'Current page' },
  ]}
/>

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the root `<nav>` element.

props.name: separator
props.description:
Name of the icon rendered between consecutive items. The separator is hidden from assistive
technology.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Overrides the built-in strings for this instance. The only key is `label`, the default
`aria-label` of the `<nav>` (default `'breadcrumb'`). An explicit `aria-label` prop wins.

props.name: wrap
props.description:
Whether the trail wraps onto more lines when it is wider than its container. When `false`,
it stays on one line and the overflow is clipped.

item.description: An individual item in the breadcrumb trail.

props.name: active
props.description:
Marks this item as the current page, rendered as a non-link with `aria-current="page"`. When
no item sets it, the last item is the current page. The first item with `active` wins.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the item is disabled: it renders as a non-interactive element with
`aria-disabled="true"` and without `href` or `onClick`. Has no effect on the current page.

props.name: href
props.description:
Link destination. Applied only to an interactive item: the current page and disabled items
render without `href`, `target`, `rel` and `onClick`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Name of an icon rendered before the label.

props.name: label
props.description: Text or content of the item. Nothing is rendered for an empty label.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler for the item's link. Not attached to the current page or disabled items.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship, such as `'noopener'`. Ignored for the current page and disabled items.

props.name: target
props.description: Browsing context for the link, such as `'_blank'`. Ignored for the current page and disabled items.
